* Synthesize a key event. It is targeted at whatever would be targeted by an
 * actual keypress by the user, typically the focused element.
 *
 * @param {string|integer} aKey - Should be:
 *  - key value (recommended).  If you specify a non-printable key name,
 *    append "KEY_" prefix.  Otherwise, specifying a printable key, the
 *    key value should be specified.
 *  - keyCode name starting with "VK_" (e.g., VK_RETURN).  This is available
 *    only for compatibility with legacy API.  Don't use this with new tests.
 *
 * @param {object} aEvent - An object which may contain the properties.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The accepted synthesizeKey documentation recommends key values with KEY_ for non-printable keys and retains VK_ only for legacy compatibility. The implementation strips those prefixes and builds a keyboard event dictionary. Recommend this helper-specific syntax for new tests while preserving existing callers; the documentation cleanup does not authorize a project-wide key-name rewrite. title: Prefer the documented key-value form for new EventUtils tests
